### A

```{r single-index-estimates}
a <- read.csv("../../data/stockData.csv", check.names = FALSE)
a$Date <- as.Date(a$Date)
a <- a[a$Date >= as.Date("2018-01-01") &
         a$Date < as.Date("2023-01-01"), ]
stocks <- setdiff(names(a), c("Date", "^GSPC"))
prices <- as.matrix(a[, c("^GSPC", stocks)])
r <- prices[-1, ] / prices[-nrow(prices), ] - 1
market <- r[, "^GSPC"]

alpha <- beta <- residual_var <- numeric(30)
for (i in seq_along(stocks)) {
  fit <- lm(r[, stocks[i]] ~ market)
  alpha[i] <- coef(fit)[1]
  beta[i] <- coef(fit)[2]
  residual_var[i] <- summary(fit)$sigma^2
}
kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks, Alpha = alpha, Beta = beta,
                 Residual_variance = residual_var),
      digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
```

### B

```{r single-index-covariance}
Sigma_index <- outer(beta, beta) * var(market) + diag(residual_var)
dimnames(Sigma_index) <- list(stocks, stocks)
round(Sigma_index, 6)
```

### C

```{r compare-frontiers}
mu <- alpha + beta * mean(market)
covariances <- list(Historical = cov(r[, stocks]),
                    "Single index" = Sigma_index)
curves <- list()
sd_max <- 1.05 * max(sqrt(diag(cov(r))))

for (model in names(covariances)) {
  Sigma <- covariances[[model]]
  u <- solve(Sigma, mu)
  v <- solve(Sigma, rep(1, 30))
  A <- sum(u)
  B <- sum(mu * u)
  C <- sum(v)
  D <- B * C - A^2
  sd_grid <- seq(sqrt(1 / C), sd_max, length.out = 500)
  offset <- sqrt((D / C) * pmax(sd_grid^2 - 1 / C, 0))
  curves[[model]] <- data.frame(
    SD = rep(sd_grid, 2),
    Mean = c(A / C + offset, A / C - offset),
    Branch = rep(c("Efficient", "Inefficient"), each = 500),
    Model = model
  )
}
frontiers <- do.call(rbind, curves)
ggplot(frontiers, aes(x = 100 * SD, y = 100 * Mean,
                     color = Model, linetype = Branch)) +
  geom_path() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Efficient = "solid",
                                  Inefficient = "dashed")) +
  labs(x = "Monthly standard deviation (%)",
       y = "Mean monthly return (%)", linetype = "Frontier") +
  theme_minimal()
```
